name: Naruto: Konoha's Last Man
source: In this game, you control Yahiro, a young student who ends up entering a fantastic to him, yet so familiar to us, world... In order to return home, he will have to understand his purpose in that world and, above all, whether he will be able to be the hero that these people need.​
translation: 在这款游戏中，你控制着年轻的学生八寻，他最终进入了一个对他来说很奇妙，但对我们来说却如此熟悉的世界……为了回家，他必须了解自己在那个世界的目的，最重要的是，他是否能够成为这些人需要的英雄。
